NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Fetch and verify the exact source commit, materialize the isolated copy, implement only the finite temporal-arm criteria below, then return one evidence-bearing PROGRESS and one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED.
REASON: M837_SOURCE_HARDENING_COMPLETE_NEXT_FINITE_GATE

SOURCE_ATTESTATION: This exact commit is the Codex-verified source commit read back from origin after M837. Resolve and verify this commit before copying; do not substitute a moving branch tip or any older R-lane checkout.
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f81-f84-temporal-guidance-current-r1
COPY_ROOT_RULE: Create or use only this isolated copy. Never edit the source checkout, another task copy, live release, generated output, or deployment files.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, provider calls, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, generated output, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
MISSION: Close one documented F81/F84 gap in the existing variant/learning architecture: explicit validated timing is present in GuidanceEvidence and caption receipts, but the learn-v2 arm identity/parser and the reachable observed-pattern consumer currently carry hook and format without a timing dimension. Implement this as a bounded extension of the existing contract; do not create a parallel learning model, table, migration, or provider path.
SOURCE_AUDIT_REQUIRED: Read the existing packages/core/src/learning-contract.ts, packages/worker/src/learning-state.ts and tests, packages/worker/src/caption-guidance.ts, packages/worker/src/viral-retrieval.ts, packages/worker/src/recipe-evidence.ts, packages/api/src/variant-guidance.ts and tests, and packages/dashboard/components/PerformancePatterns.tsx before editing. The current source already enforces source-variant ownership in packages/api/src/routes/variant-experiments.ts; do not reopen that closed M837 issue.
IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE: Extend the existing learn-v2 arm grammar with one bounded timing qualifier only when the server-owned, caption-hash-verified receipt contains a valid timingBucket. Keep old learn-v1 and old learn-v2 arms parseable and selection-compatible. If postingHourUtc is present without a valid timingBucket, preserve the hour as evidence but do not invent a timing qualifier. If both are present, preserve the existing consistency check. Thread the explicit timing qualifier through learningStructure, parseLearningArm/isLearningArm, retrieval selection and publication evidence without changing the existing context namespace or posterior storage model. Update the reachable PerformancePatterns or equivalent observed-pattern surface to display the verified timing qualifier/evidence with clear observed-versus-scheduled/no-causality wording; unknown remains unknown.
PROVENANCE_RULE: Only server-owned caption-guidance receipts with a matching caption hash may influence a temporal arm. Never accept a client-provided arm, infer actual publication time from scheduled time, or turn missing timing into a default.
COMPATIBILITY_RULE: Existing arms such as short:question and v2:short:statement:hook=question:format=reel remain valid. Invalid or unsupported timing tokens must be rejected by the shared parser and never reach learning selection. Do not change database schemas, migrations, RLS, provider contracts, or experiment publication behavior.
PASS_1: Changed product source must be reachable from the existing worker publication/retrieval path or authenticated API projection and the existing dashboard observed-pattern surface. A helper-only, contract-only, docs-only, copied-baseline or generated-output change fails.
PASS_2: Tests must cover legacy arm compatibility; valid timing-qualified v2 arms; invalid timing token rejection; timingBucket/postingHour consistency; receipt hash mismatch or untrusted evidence exclusion; hour-only evidence remaining unqualified; retrieval selection retaining qualified arms; and truthful dashboard timing/unknown copy. Exercise real callsites, not only pure parser helpers.
PASS_3: Preserve tenant/model/platform scoping, RLS assumptions, idempotency, replay safety, the existing recency/decay behavior, observed-versus-selected separation, and explicit no-causality language. Do not add a migration or persist raw caption/provider payloads.
PASS_4: Run focused core/worker/API/dashboard behavior tests plus typechecks and builds/lint for every changed package; report exact commands and real exit codes. No live provider, database, deployment or runtime action.
PASS_5: DELIVERY must include exact SOURCE_REF, COPY_ROOT, changed paths, per-file SHA-256, behavior-test names/counts, exact exits and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE, plus explicit confirmation that no deployment, installer, migration execution, database, provider, credential, permission, network, systemd or runtime action occurred.
BLOCK_RULE: If the current architecture cannot support the timing qualifier without a schema, migration or unsupported inference, return one terminal BLOCKED naming the exact file and missing prerequisite. Do not send another ACK-only response or unchanged PROGRESS.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: One Codex audit only. No stale lane may resume, no repeated ACK loop is accepted, and no source archive substitution is authorized. Every reply must correlate to this exact WIRE, avoid dates/clocks/timestamps for coordination, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
